query:
SELECT COUNT(*)                                                     AS "count!: i64"
        FROM goals go
        JOIN events e ON e.id = go.event_id
        JOIN games g ON g.game_id = e.game_id
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shots s WHERE s.event_id = go.event_id)
          AND ($1::integer IS NULL OR g.season = $1)
